command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "=== boot id ==="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id 2>/dev/null || true
uptime -s 2>/dev/null || true
echo "=== os release ==="
cat /etc/os-release | head -5
echo "=== current sysctl values (pre-change) ==="
sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route
echo "=== existing sysctl.conf / sysctl.d ==="
grep -RIn "accept_redirects\|accept_source_route" /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/ 2>/dev/null || echo "none found"

net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0
EOF
cat /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf

echo "=== applying now ==="
sudo -n sysctl -p /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf

echo "=== verify live values ==="
